summary: Resolve bounded sample-entry indices into multiple self-contained MP4 data references

before.specific_failure: A valid two-local-URL movie is rejected by the one-entry dref restriction. Non-one SampleEntry indices are also hardcoded invalid. Single-reference and existing-refusal controls pass; multi-table index-specific refusals originally stop at the unrelated cardinality restriction.

resources: Metadata cap128 and packet cap1 continue refusing. Largest-index catalog is below1MiB; every reference entry is validated, using the existing metadata-bounded catalog allocation.
migration: No public signature change. Local reference indices1..catalog length are accepted; every entry must retain the existing exact self-contained URL/alias form.
limits: External references, extra location payloads and unknown reference formats remain unsupported, including unused external entries.
